clauses: Any work performed outside the agreed scope of services listed in this contract, including emergency or weekend callouts, must be pre-approved in writing by the client before billing and is subject to a separate quote rather than standard line-item rates.
Late payment beyond the agreed Net 15 terms will attract a 1.5% per month penalty on the outstanding amount, applied from the due date.
Either party may terminate this agreement with 30 days written notice. Any work in progress at termination will be billed on a pro-rata basis.
Annual license renewal invoices are issued 30 days in advance of the renewal date and are non-refundable once processed.
Bulk orders above Rs. 50,000 are eligible for a 5% volume discount, applied automatically at invoicing.
Damaged or incorrect items must be reported within 7 days of delivery for replacement; no cash refunds are issued.
Payment terms are Net 30 from invoice date; early payment within 10 days qualifies for a 2% early-payment discount.
Fuel surcharge is recalculated monthly based on prevailing diesel prices and is capped at 12% of the base freight charge.
Delayed deliveries beyond the agreed SLA window are subject to a service credit of 2% of the invoice value per day delayed, up to a maximum of 10%.
Payment terms are Net 20 from invoice date. Disputed line items must be raised within 5 business days of receipt.
Hourly consultation rates are billed in 30-minute increments; partial hours are rounded up.
Retainer clients receive a 10% discount on contract drafting services booked in the same billing cycle.
All invoices are due Net 15. Overdue invoices beyond 45 days may result in suspension of ongoing engagements.
Custom print runs require a signed proof approval before production; changes after approval are billed separately.
Minimum order quantity discounts apply above 10,000 units at a rate of 8% off list pricing.
Payment terms are Net 30. A 50% advance is required for custom print runs exceeding Rs. 25,000.
